messages:
Lena M: Hi all, joined yesterday and noticed the "orientation" block on my calendar for Monday 09:00 but no meeting link. Calendar shows the event in ET for me, but the invite creator listed PT. Can someone confirm the actual start time in UTC and repost the link? Also Id love to know where recordings go for folks in different regions.

Raj Patel: Welcome Lena! :wave: Core orientation is Mon 09:00 PT (so 16:00 UTC). For quick conversions: PT -> add 7 hours for UTC during PDT. If you're on ET, that'll be 12:00 local. Ill paste the Zoom shortly.

Onboarding Bot: Note: Orientation events default to Pacific Time. Recordings are uploaded to Drive under /company/onboarding/recordings within 24hrs. Transcripts enabled.

Lena M: Thanks Raj. My Google Calendar auto-shifted it to 16:00 (UTC) which made me think it was 16:00 local. Could we add explicit timezone labels and meeting link in the event description?

Cory (IT): We can do that for future invites. For this one the Zoom is: https://zoom.us/j/2345678901 (passcode: redwood). If you can't see the link in the invite, open the event from the shared "Redwood Onboarding" calendar rather than the mailer. Some clients hide details on duplicate invites.

Nina H: FYI there are two separate sessions: [CORE] 09:00 PT and [REGIONS] 14:00 PT (regional office hours). The [REGIONS] session will cover local benefits, security onboarding, and infra creds. If youre remote in EMEA/APAC, join REGIONS for your locale questions; CORE is the company-wide intro.

Lena M: Where will recordings be organized? My manager wants me to watch the Core recording before our 1:1. Do we have chapters or timestamps?

Marta (People Ops): Recordings go to Drive: https://drive.reddemo.company/onboarding/ (we create a subfolder per session and add a timestamped agenda doc). We try to include chapter markers and a short timestamped outline within the Drive doc. If there's any accessibility need (captions, alt-text), reply here and well prioritize it.

Raj Patel: Also, if your calendar shows the wrong timezone, check Settings -> Time Zone in Google Calendar and ensure "Ask to update" is on. Guests sometimes receive invites in organizer timezone (PT) and clients show them as UTC; small confusion but common.

Lena M: Appreciate the help. One more: will the attendance be marked somewhere or do we just accept the invite?

Onboarding Bot: Attendance is captured via calendar accept/decline and a post-event poll in the onboarding Drive doc.

Cory (IT): If anyone can't access the Drive folder after the recording is posted, DM me and I'll add direct access.

Lena M: Great. Ill accept the invite and aim to join at 16:00 UTC (12:00 ET). Thanks everyone!

Marta (People Ops): Welcome again, Lena 64f. Well follow up with the folder link and a short agenda before the session.
